jobs.title: School Counsellor (Short -Term cover 80%)
jobs.description:
For an immediate start - initially until 30 November 2026 OUR PHILOSOPHY At Beau Soleil, we believe it’s what you do that counts. This philosophy holds true in all that we do as staff and for our students. We are a community that believes in the power of action, engagement and participation, inside and outside of the classroom. Our unique holistic education is built around four core values: Respect, Responsibility, Ambition and Determination, which provide a framework to community life for our international student body. Our students come from over sixty different countries, with diverse academic backgrounds and a wide range of future aspirations. With curricular programmes in both English and French, students graduate with an IB or High School Diploma. Within this framework, small class sizes allow for a flexible programme and staff are encouraged and supported to bring new ideas to all that they do. OUR COMMUNITY Our location in the heart of Villars-sur-Ollon, offers an enviable lifestyle with access to skiing in the winter months and a multitude of outdoor and sporting activities throughout the year. Montreux, Lausanne and Geneva are all within easy reach for cultural adventures and inspiration. The Beau Soleil campus is an inspiring place to work with facilities that are second to none. Our ongoing campus development and maintenence programme ensures that our students and staff thrive in an environment of which they can be rightly proud. YOUR PROFILE At Beau Soleil, student wellbeing is at the heart of our pastoral care. We are looking for an experienced School Counsellor to provide short-term cover and support our international boarding school community. You will provide confidential and professional support to students experiencing emotional, social, behavioural or adjustment difficulties, helping them navigate the challenges of adolescence and life away from home. Working closely with our pastoral, boarding, safeguarding and academic teams, you will help ensure that students receive appropriate and timely support in a safe and caring environment. We are looking for someone who can quickly build trusting relationships with young people and who brings a calm, empathetic and professional approach to sensitive situations. This is an 80% position, starting as soon as possible and initially running until the end of November 2026, with the possibility of extension. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide confidential individual counselling and wellbeing support to students
• Assess students’ needs and develop appropriate short-term support strategies
• Support students experiencing emotional, social, relational or adjustment difficulties
• Work closely with pastoral, boarding and academic teams to support student wellbeing
• Contribute to safeguarding and child protection procedures, working closely with the Designated Safeguarding Lead
• Liaise appropriately with parents and external professionals when required
• Maintain accurate and confidential counselling records
• Provide support in urgent or sensitive student wellbeing situations EDUCATION AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
• Master’s degree in Psychology, Counselling or a related field
• Professional training in counselling or psychotherapy
• Recognised professional accreditation, or eligibility for accreditation, would be an advantage
• Fluent English is essential; French would be an advantage EXPERIENCE
• 3–5 years’ experience working with children or adolescents
• Experience in an international or boarding school environment would be an advantage
• Experience working with students from diverse cultural backgrounds PERSON SPECIFICATION
• Warm, empathetic and able to build trust with adolescents
• Calm and professional when dealing with sensitive or challenging situations
• High level of discretion and professional ethics
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills
• Culturally sensitive and comfortable working in an international environment
• Able to work collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team HOW TO APPLY Applications should be made via Beau Soleil recruitment website, https://www.beausoleil.ch/careers and should contain a CV, letter of application and the details of two professional referees. The closing date for applications is Friday, 16 October 2026 . Successful short listed candidates will be contacted straight away with initial discussions conducted remotely by telephone or video call. Collège Alpin Beau Soleil is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. A police check is required prior to appointment.

Questa filosofia vale in tutto ciò che facciamo come personale e per i nostri studenti. Siamo una comunità che crede nel potere di azione, impegno e partecipazione, dentro e fuori della classe. La nostra formazione olistica unica è costruita intorno a quattro valori fondamentali: Rispetto, Responsabilità, Ambizione e Determinazione, che forniscono un quadro per la vita comunitaria per il nostro corpo studentesco internazionale. I nostri studenti provengono da oltre sessanta paesi diversi, con diversi background accademici e una vasta gamma di aspirazioni future. Con programmi curriculari sia in inglese che in francese, gli studenti si diplomano con un diploma di IB o High School. All'interno di questo quadro, le piccole dimensioni di classe permettono un programma flessibile e il personale è incoraggiato e sostenuto per portare nuove idee a tutto ciò che fanno. LA NOSTRA COMUNITÀ La nostra posizione nel cuore di Villars-sur-Ollon, offre uno stile di vita invidiabile con accesso allo sci nei mesi invernali e una moltitudine di attività all'aperto e sportive durante tutto l'anno. Montreux, Losanna e Ginevra sono tutti facilmente raggiungibili per avventure culturali e ispirazione. Il campus Beau Soleil è un luogo ispiratore per lavorare con strutture che non sono seconda a nessuno. Il nostro continuo programma di sviluppo e manutenzione del campus assicura che i nostri studenti e personale prosperano in un ambiente di cui possono essere giustamente orgogliosi. A Beau Soleil, il benessere degli studenti è al centro della nostra pastorale. Stiamo cercando un consulente scolastico esperto per fornire copertura a breve termine e sostenere la nostra comunità internazionale di imbarco scolastico. Fornirai un supporto confidenziale e professionale agli studenti che vivono difficoltà emozionali, sociali, comportamentali o di regolazione, aiutandoli a navigare nelle sfide dell'adolescenza e della vita lontano da casa. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i nostri team pastorali, di imbarco, di salvaguardia e accademici, vi aiuterà a garantire che gli studenti ricevano un sostegno adeguato e tempestivo in un ambiente sicuro e curato. Stiamo cercando qualcuno che possa rapidamente costruire relazioni di fiducia con i giovani e che porta un approccio calmo, empatico e professionale a situazioni sensibili. Si tratta di una posizione dell'80%, a partire dal più presto possibile e inizialmente in esecuzione fino alla fine di novembre 2026, con la possibilità di estensione. RISPOSTE DI LAVORO
• Fornire consulenza individuale confidenziale e supporto benessere agli studenti
• Valutare le esigenze degli studenti e sviluppare strategie di sostegno a breve termine appropriate
• Sostenere gli studenti che sperimentano difficoltà emotive, sociali, relazionali o di regolazione
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con team pastorali, di imbarco e accademici per sostenere il benessere degli studenti
• Contribuire a salvaguardare e proteggere i bambini, lavorando a stretto contatto con il Piombo di Protezione Progettato
• Liaise in modo appropriato con genitori e professionisti esterni quando richiesto
• Mantenere registrazioni di consulenza accurate e riservate
• Fornire supporto in situazioni di benessere degli studenti urgenti o sensibili
• Master in Psicologia, Consulenza o un campo correlato
• Formazione professionale in consulenza o psicoterapia
• L'accreditamento professionale riconosciuto, o l'ammissibilità per l'accreditamento, sarebbe un vantaggio
• L'inglese fluente è essenziale; il francese sarebbe un vantaggio
• Esperienza di 3-5 anni con bambini o adolescenti
• L'esperienza in un ambiente scolastico internazionale o di imbarco sarebbe un vantaggio
• Esperienza di lavoro con studenti provenienti da diversi background culturali PERSONA SPECIFICA
• Caldo, empatico e in grado di costruire fiducia con gli adolescenti
• Calma e professionale quando si tratta di situazioni sensibili o difficili
• Alto livello di discrezione ed etica professionale
• Forte capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione
• Culturalmente sensibile e confortevole lavorare in un ambiente internazionale
• In grado di lavorare in collaborazione nell'ambito di un team multidisciplinare COME APPLICARE Le domande devono essere effettuate tramite il sito di reclutamento Beau Soleil, https://www.beausoleil.ch/careers e devono contenere un CV, una lettera di domanda e i dettagli di due refere professionali. La data di chiusura delle domande è venerdì 16 ottobre 2026 . I candidati selezionati saranno immediatamente contattati con le discussioni iniziali condotte da remoto tramite telefono o videochiamata. Collège Alpin Beau Soleil si impegna a salvaguardare e promuovere il benessere dei bambini e dei giovani. Un controllo della polizia è richiesto prima dell'appuntamento.

Für einen sofortigen Start - zunächst bis zum 30. November 2026 UNSERE PHILOSOPHIE Bei Beau Soleil glauben wir, dass es zählt, was Sie tun. Diese Philosophie gilt für alles, was wir als Mitarbeiter und für unsere Studenten tun. Wir sind eine Gemeinschaft, die an die Kraft des Handelns, des Engagements und der Beteiligung innerhalb und außerhalb des Klassenzimmers glaubt. Unsere einzigartige ganzheitliche Ausbildung basiert auf vier Kernwerten: Respekt, Verantwortung, Ehrgeiz und Entschlossenheit, die einen Rahmen für das Gemeinschaftsleben für unsere internationale Studentenschaft bieten. Unsere Studenten kommen aus über sechzig verschiedenen Ländern, mit unterschiedlichen akademischen Hintergründen und einer breiten Palette von zukünftigen Ambitionen. Mit curricularen Programmen in Englisch und Französisch absolvieren die Schüler ein IB- oder High School-Diplom. Innerhalb dieses Rahmens ermöglichen kleine Klassengrößen ein flexibles Programm, und die Mitarbeiter werden ermutigt und unterstützt, neue Ideen in all das einzubringen, was sie tun. UNSERE GEMEINSCHAFT Unsere Lage im Herzen von Villars-sur-Ollon bietet einen beneidenswerten Lebensstil mit Zugang zum Skifahren in den Wintermonaten und einer Vielzahl von Outdoor- und Sportaktivitäten das ganze Jahr über. Montreux, Lausanne und Genf sind alle leicht zu erreichen für kulturelle Abenteuer und Inspiration. Der Beau Soleil Campus ist ein inspirierender Ort, um mit Einrichtungen zu arbeiten, die unübertroffen sind. Unser fortlaufendes Campus-Entwicklungs- und Wartungsprogramm stellt sicher, dass unsere Studenten und Mitarbeiter in einem Umfeld gedeihen, auf das sie zu Recht stolz sein können. IHR PROFIL Bei Beau Soleil steht das Wohlbefinden der Studierenden im Mittelpunkt unserer Seelsorge. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Schulberater, der kurzfristige Deckung bietet und unsere internationale Internatsgemeinschaft unterstützt. Sie bieten vertrauliche und professionelle Unterstützung für Studenten, die emotionale, soziale, Verhaltens- oder Anpassungsschwierigkeiten haben, und helfen ihnen, die Herausforderungen der Jugend und des Lebens von zu Hause weg zu meistern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren pastoralen, Internats-, Sicherheits- und akademischen Teams werden Sie dazu beitragen, dass die Schüler in einer sicheren und fürsorglichen Umgebung angemessene und rechtzeitige Unterstützung erhalten. Wir suchen jemanden, der schnell vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu jungen Menschen aufbauen kann und der eine ruhige, einfühlsame und professionelle Herangehensweise an sensible Situationen mitbringt. Dies ist eine 80% -Position, die so schnell wie möglich beginnt und zunächst bis Ende November 2026 läuft, mit der Möglichkeit einer Verlängerung. WICHTIGKEITEN

jobs.description:
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE The Bilingual Learning Support Teacher provides flexible learning support services across the school according to operational needs. The role focuses on identifying students' learning needs and supporting them in achieving their full potential within the classroom environment whenever possible. The Learning Support Teacher collaborates closely with teachers, school leaders, parents, and external professionals to ensure that support strategies are aligned with individual student needs. In partnership with classroom teachers, the Learning Support Teacher develops and delivers targeted interventions that can, where appropriate, be integrated into regular classroom practice. This position offers flexible assignments based on the school's requirements and may involve supporting students across different year groups and learning support programmes. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES The Learning Support Teacher is responsible, in collaboration with the teacher, for:
• Planning, organising and implementing specific interventions to develop literacy, numeracy and language skills for students who have identified specific learning differences (to include HP)
• Providing in class’s support or small groups pull-outs as appropriate
• Providing 1:1 support for those students with significant learning differences which have been identified by an external evaluation. This involves:
• Completing student observations and evaluations.
• Collaborating with teachers to provide classroom management suggestions and plans regarding identified students
• Mentoring assistants and support staff as appropriate
• Communication with parents in collaboration with the classroom teacher, Principals and/or Deputies
• Collaborating with School Counsellor and external specialists
• Providing regular feedback to principal/deputies. Additional Responsibilities
• Presenting a positive role model by employing appropriate and respectful interactions with students and staff
• Maintaining own records for identified students.
• Leading workshops with teachers and other staff for professional development
• Remaining current in the field of Learning Differences by attending in-service programs, mandated staff meetings trainings and self-selected workshops and conferences.
• Attending reviews or other related meetings
• Assisting with playground supervision and special activities as requested. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES (The abilities that the individual needs in order to perform this role effectively)
• Good organisational skills
• Establish and maintain positive relationships with students and parents.
• Ability to take initiative and accept responsibility
• Awareness of confidential processes and an ability to respect confidentiality
• Ability to work as part of a team
• Dynamic, committed yet flexible
• Willingness to embrace the latest developments in education for those with Learning Differences (including HP) and a commitment to ongoing Professional Development
• Ability to use IPADS/computers to stimulate interest in learning
• Ability to work with administrative and regular Office software (Word, Excel, Outlook...)
• Assessing students formally and informally including standardised assessments, screeners and use these to assess data to inform support for those students in need.
• Providing regular feedback on progress and achievements to individual student's teachers and parents.
• The learning support teacher will serve as a case manager for students receiving learning support services, including writing IEPs and keeping the students learning support master list up to date
• Fluent in English (level C1 minimum reading/writing speaking).French desirable at B1 level. Desirable skills:
• Familiar with the MTSS inclusive framework
• Experience in administrating standardiaed assessments and diagnostic screeners.
• A minimum of 2 years of special educational/learning support teaching in a diverse setting QUALIFICATION To be considered for this position, you must possess a BA (QTS)/BSc (QTS) or equivalent, or a BA/BSc with a PGCE or MA in Special Education. Alternatively, a B.Ed or CAPSAIS/CAPA-SH qualification is also acceptable. Preferred qualifications include experience in Speech and Language Therapy. EXPERIENCE In terms of experience, you should demonstrate an ability to evaluate a student’s needs and develop appropriate interventions, both in small group settings and within larger classes. Previous experience working with Preschool/Primary aged children with specific learning needs is highly valued, as well as an understanding of confidential processes and a commitment to respecting confidentiality. Additionally, experience with different cultures and familiarity with programmes for high-potential (HP) students are considered advantageous. ESSENTIAL INFORMATION It is important that the post holder is always aware of Child Protection guidelines and observes a professional distance from students whilst still developing effective working and caring relationships. You understand and embrace the importance of diversity and inclusion and stand against discrimination in any form. Background investigations and reference checks for the past ten years will be conducted during the selection process. WHO WE ARE Collège du Léman is one of Switzerland’s most prestigious international schools, located on the edge of Lake Geneva in view of the Swiss Alps. ​ We welcome children from 2 to 18 years old to become part of a truly international community with more than 120 different nationalities. Our vision is to shape generations that harness differences and empower our students to change the world for the better. We nurture individual strengths through our outstanding educators and the sheer breadth of opportunities that we offer as part of our curriculum and activities.

Il Learning Support Teacher collabora a stretto contatto con insegnanti, dirigenti scolastici, genitori e professionisti esterni per garantire che le strategie di supporto siano allineate alle esigenze individuali degli studenti. In collaborazione con gli insegnanti in aula, l'insegnante di supporto all'apprendimento sviluppa e fornisce interventi mirati che possono, se del caso, essere integrati nella pratica regolare dell'aula. Questa posizione offre incarichi flessibili in base alle esigenze della scuola e può coinvolgere studenti di supporto in diversi gruppi di anni e programmi di supporto all'apprendimento. RISPOSTE DI LAVORO L'insegnante di supporto all'apprendimento è responsabile, in collaborazione con l'insegnante, per:
• Pianificazione, organizzazione e attuazione di interventi specifici per sviluppare l'alfabetizzazione, la numerazione e le competenze linguistiche per gli studenti che hanno identificato differenze di apprendimento specifiche (per includere HP)
• Fornire in supporto di classe o piccoli gruppi pull-out come appropriato
• Fornire un supporto 1:1 per quegli studenti con significative differenze di apprendimento che sono state identificate da una valutazione esterna. Ciò comporta:
• Completare osservazioni e valutazioni degli studenti.
• Collaborare con gli insegnanti per fornire suggerimenti e piani di gestione delle aule per gli studenti identificati
• Assistenti di mentoring e personale di supporto come opportuno
• Comunicazione con i genitori in collaborazione con l'insegnante in aula, preside e/o deputati
• Collaborare con il consigliere scolastico e specialisti esterni
• Fornire un feedback regolare ai principali / deputati. Responsabilità aggiuntive
• Presentare un modello di ruolo positivo impiegando interazioni appropriate e rispettose con studenti e personale
• Mantenere i propri registri per gli studenti identificati.
• Laboratori leader con insegnanti e altri collaboratori per lo sviluppo professionale
• Rimanente corrente nel campo delle Differenze di apprendimento partecipando a programmi in-service, incaricati incontri del personale corsi di formazione e workshop auto-selezionati e conferenze.
• Partecipare a recensioni o altri incontri correlati
• Assistere con supervisione del parco giochi e attività speciali come richiesto. SKILLE E COMPETENZE (Le capacità che l'individuo ha bisogno per svolgere questo ruolo in modo efficace)
• Buone capacità organizzative
• Stabilire e mantenere relazioni positive con studenti e genitori.
• Capacità di prendere iniziativa e di accettare la responsabilità
• Consapevolezza dei processi riservati e la capacità di rispettare la riservatezza
• Capacità di lavorare come parte di un team
• Dinamica, impegnata ma flessibile
• Volontà di abbracciare gli ultimi sviluppi dell'istruzione per coloro che hanno differenze di apprendimento (compreso HP) e un impegno per lo sviluppo professionale in corso
• Capacità di utilizzare IPADS/computer per stimolare l'interesse nell'apprendimento
• Capacità di lavorare con il software di Office amministrativo e regolare (Word, Excel, Outlook...)
• Valutare gli studenti formalmente e informalmente, comprese le valutazioni standardizzate, gli screener e usarli per valutare i dati per informare il supporto per quegli studenti bisognosi.
• Fornire un feedback regolare sui progressi e i risultati dei singoli insegnanti e genitori dello studente.
• L'insegnante di supporto per l'apprendimento servirà come gestore di casi per gli studenti che ricevono servizi di supporto per l'apprendimento, tra cui scrivere IEP e mantenere gli studenti che imparano la lista master fino ad oggi
• Fluente in inglese (livello C1 minimo di lettura / scrittura di parlare). Francese desiderabile a livello B1. Capacità discreti:
• Familiare con il framework MTSS inclusi
• Esperienza nell'amministrare valutazioni standard e screener diagnostici.
• Un minimo di 2 anni di speciale insegnamento di supporto educativo/apprendimento in un ambiente diverso QUALIFICAZIONE Per essere considerato per questa posizione, è necessario possedere un BA (QTS)/BSc (QTS) o equivalente, o un BA/BSc con un PGCE o MA in Educazione Speciale. In alternativa, è accettabile anche una qualifica B.Ed o CAPSAIS/CAPA-SH. Le qualifiche predeterminate includono l'esperienza nel linguaggio e nella terapia linguistica. ESPERIENZA In termini di esperienza, si dovrebbe dimostrare la capacità di valutare le esigenze di uno studente e sviluppare interventi appropriati, sia in piccole impostazioni di gruppo che in classi più grandi. L'esperienza precedente che lavora con i bambini in età prescolare/primaria con specifiche esigenze di apprendimento è molto apprezzata, così come la comprensione dei processi confidenziali e l'impegno a rispettare la riservatezza. Inoltre, l'esperienza con culture diverse e la familiarità con i programmi per gli studenti ad alto potenziale (HP) sono considerati vantaggiosi. INFORMAZIONI ESSENTI È importante che il titolare del post sia sempre a conoscenza delle linee guida per la protezione dei bambini e osservi una distanza professionale dagli studenti, pur sviluppando relazioni di lavoro e cura efficaci. Voi comprendete e abbracciate l'importanza della diversità e dell'inclusione e mettetevi contro la discriminazione in qualsiasi forma. Le indagini di fondo e i controlli di riferimento per gli ultimi dieci anni saranno condotti durante il processo di selezione. CHI SIAMO Collège du Léman è una delle scuole internazionali più prestigiose della Svizzera, situata ai margini del Lago di Ginevra in vista delle Alpi svizzere. Accogliamo i bambini dai 2 ai 18 anni per entrare a far parte di una comunità internazionale con più di 120 nazionalità diverse. La nostra visione è quella di modellare le generazioni che sfruttano le differenze e permettono ai nostri studenti di cambiare il mondo per il meglio. Nutriamo i punti di forza individuali attraverso i nostri eccellenti educatori e la pura ampiezza delle opportunità che offriamo come parte del nostro curriculum e delle nostre attività.
descriptionByLocale.en:
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE The Bilingual Learning Support Teacher provides flexible learning support services across the school according to operational needs. The role focuses on identifying students' learning needs and supporting them in achieving their full potential within the classroom environment whenever possible. The Learning Support Teacher collaborates closely with teachers, school leaders, parents, and external professionals to ensure that support strategies are aligned with individual student needs. In partnership with classroom teachers, the Learning Support Teacher develops and delivers targeted interventions that can, where appropriate, be integrated into regular classroom practice. This position offers flexible assignments based on the school's requirements and may involve supporting students across different year groups and learning support programmes. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES The Learning Support Teacher is responsible, in collaboration with the teacher, for:
• Planning, organising and implementing specific interventions to develop literacy, numeracy and language skills for students who have identified specific learning differences (to include HP)
• Providing in class’s support or small groups pull-outs as appropriate
• Providing 1:1 support for those students with significant learning differences which have been identified by an external evaluation. This involves:
• Completing student observations and evaluations.
• Collaborating with teachers to provide classroom management suggestions and plans regarding identified students
• Mentoring assistants and support staff as appropriate
• Communication with parents in collaboration with the classroom teacher, Principals and/or Deputies
• Collaborating with School Counsellor and external specialists
• Providing regular feedback to principal/deputies. Additional Responsibilities
• Presenting a positive role model by employing appropriate and respectful interactions with students and staff
• Maintaining own records for identified students.
• Leading workshops with teachers and other staff for professional development
• Remaining current in the field of Learning Differences by attending in-service programs, mandated staff meetings trainings and self-selected workshops and conferences.
• Attending reviews or other related meetings
• Assisting with playground supervision and special activities as requested. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES (The abilities that the individual needs in order to perform this role effectively)
• Good organisational skills
• Establish and maintain positive relationships with students and parents.
• Ability to take initiative and accept responsibility
• Awareness of confidential processes and an ability to respect confidentiality
• Ability to work as part of a team
• Dynamic, committed yet flexible
• Willingness to embrace the latest developments in education for those with Learning Differences (including HP) and a commitment to ongoing Professional Development
• Ability to use IPADS/computers to stimulate interest in learning
• Ability to work with administrative and regular Office software (Word, Excel, Outlook...)
• Assessing students formally and informally including standardised assessments, screeners and use these to assess data to inform support for those students in need.
• Providing regular feedback on progress and achievements to individual student's teachers and parents.
• The learning support teacher will serve as a case manager for students receiving learning support services, including writing IEPs and keeping the students learning support master list up to date
• Fluent in English (level C1 minimum reading/writing speaking).French desirable at B1 level. Desirable skills:
• Familiar with the MTSS inclusive framework
• Experience in administrating standardiaed assessments and diagnostic screeners.
• A minimum of 2 years of special educational/learning support teaching in a diverse setting QUALIFICATION To be considered for this position, you must possess a BA (QTS)/BSc (QTS) or equivalent, or a BA/BSc with a PGCE or MA in Special Education. Alternatively, a B.Ed or CAPSAIS/CAPA-SH qualification is also acceptable. Preferred qualifications include experience in Speech and Language Therapy. EXPERIENCE In terms of experience, you should demonstrate an ability to evaluate a student’s needs and develop appropriate interventions, both in small group settings and within larger classes. Previous experience working with Preschool/Primary aged children with specific learning needs is highly valued, as well as an understanding of confidential processes and a commitment to respecting confidentiality. Additionally, experience with different cultures and familiarity with programmes for high-potential (HP) students are considered advantageous. ESSENTIAL INFORMATION It is important that the post holder is always aware of Child Protection guidelines and observes a professional distance from students whilst still developing effective working and caring relationships. You understand and embrace the importance of diversity and inclusion and stand against discrimination in any form. Background investigations and reference checks for the past ten years will be conducted during the selection process. WHO WE ARE Collège du Léman is one of Switzerland’s most prestigious international schools, located on the edge of Lake Geneva in view of the Swiss Alps. ​ We welcome children from 2 to 18 years old to become part of a truly international community with more than 120 different nationalities. Our vision is to shape generations that harness differences and empower our students to change the world for the better. We nurture individual strengths through our outstanding educators and the sheer breadth of opportunities that we offer as part of our curriculum and activities.

Hauptzweck der Rolle Der Lehrer für bilinguales Lernen bietet flexible Lernunterstützungsdienste in der gesamten Schule entsprechend den betrieblichen Anforderungen. Die Rolle konzentriert sich darauf, die Lernbedürfnisse der Schüler zu identifizieren und sie dabei zu unterstützen, ihr volles Potenzial in der Klassenzimmerumgebung zu erreichen, wann immer dies möglich ist. Der Learning Support Teacher arbeitet eng mit Lehrern, Schulleitern, Eltern und externen Fachleuten zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Unterstützungsstrategien auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse der Schüler abgestimmt sind. In Zusammenarbeit mit Klassenlehrern entwickelt und liefert der Learning Support Teacher gezielte Interventionen, die gegebenenfalls in die reguläre Unterrichtspraxis integriert werden können. Diese Position bietet flexible Aufgaben, die auf den Anforderungen der Schule basieren, und kann die Unterstützung von Schülern in verschiedenen Jahrgangsgruppen und Lernunterstützungsprogrammen beinhalten. WICHTIGKEITEN Der Learning Support Teacher ist in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Lehrer verantwortlich für:
• Planung, Organisation und Umsetzung spezifischer Interventionen zur Entwicklung von Lese-, Rechen- und Sprachkenntnissen für Schüler, die spezifische Lernunterschiede identifiziert haben (einschließlich HP)
• Bereitstellung von Unterstützung der Klasse oder Kleingruppen Pull-outs nach Bedarf
• Bereitstellung von 1:1 Unterstützung für diejenigen Schüler mit signifikanten Lernunterschieden, die durch eine externe Bewertung identifiziert wurden. Dazu gehören:
• Abschluss der Beobachtungen und Bewertungen der Schüler.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Lehrern, um Vorschläge und Pläne für das Klassenzimmermanagement für identifizierte Schüler zu unterbreiten
• Betreuungsassistenten und gegebenenfalls Unterstützungspersonal
• Kommunikation mit den Eltern in Zusammenarbeit mit den Klassenlehrern, Schulleitern und/oder Abgeordneten
• Zusammenarbeit mit Schulberater und externen Spezialisten
• Regelmäßiges Feedback an Haupt-/Stellvertreter. Zusätzliche Zuständigkeiten
• Präsentieren eines positiven Vorbilds durch angemessene und respektvolle Interaktionen mit Studenten und Mitarbeitern
• Pflege eigener Aufzeichnungen für identifizierte Schüler.
• Leitung von Workshops mit Lehrern und anderen Mitarbeitern für die berufliche Entwicklung
• Bleiben Sie auf dem Gebiet der Lernunterschiede aktuell, indem Sie an Dienstprogrammen, Mandatssitzungen und selbst ausgewählten Workshops und Konferenzen teilnehmen.
• Teilnahme an Überprüfungen oder anderen damit verbundenen Sitzungen
• Unterstützung bei der Überwachung des Spielplatzes und bei speziellen Aktivitäten wie gewünscht. FÄHIGKEITEN UND ZUSTÄNDIGE (Die Fähigkeiten, die der Einzelne braucht, um diese Rolle effektiv zu erfüllen)
• Gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten
• Etablieren und pflegen Sie positive Beziehungen zu Schülern und Eltern.
• Fähigkeit, Initiative zu ergreifen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen
• Sensibilisierung für vertrauliche Prozesse und die Fähigkeit, Vertraulichkeit zu respektieren
• Fähigkeit, als Teil eines Teams zu arbeiten
• Dynamisch, engagiert und dennoch flexibel
• Bereitschaft, die neuesten entwicklungen in der bildung für diejenigen mit lernunterschieden (einschließlich hp) und ein engagement für die kontinuierliche berufliche entwicklung anzunehmen.
• Fähigkeit, IPADS / Computer zu verwenden, um das Interesse am Lernen zu stimulieren
• Möglichkeit, mit administrativer und regulärer Office-Software zu arbeiten (Word, Excel, Outlook ...)
• Beurteilen von Studierenden formell und informell, einschließlich standardisierter Bewertungen, Screener und verwenden Sie diese, um Daten zu bewerten, um die Unterstützung für bedürftige Studierende zu unterstützen.
• Regelmäßiges Feedback zu Fortschritten und Erfolgen für die Lehrer und Eltern der einzelnen Schüler.
• Der Lernunterstützungslehrer wird als Fallmanager für Schüler dienen, die Lernunterstützungsdienste erhalten, einschließlich des Schreibens von IEPs und der Aktualisierung der Masterliste der Schüler, die Lernunterstützung erhalten.
• Fließend in Englisch (Level C1 Minimum Lesen / Schreiben Sprechen). Französisch wünschenswert auf B1-Niveau. Erwünschte Fähigkeiten:
• Vertraut mit dem MTSS Inclusive Framework
• Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von standardisierten Assessments und diagnostischen Screeningern.
• Mindestens 2 Jahre Sonderpädagogik / Lernunterstützung Unterricht in einem vielfältigen Umfeld QUALIFIKATION Um für diese Position in Betracht gezogen zu werden, müssen Sie einen BA (QTS) / BSc (QTS) oder ein gleichwertiges oder einen BA / BSc mit einer PGCE oder MA in Special Education besitzen. Alternativ ist auch eine B.Ed- oder CAPSAIS/CAPA-SH-Qualifikation akzeptabel. Zu den bevorzugten Qualifikationen gehören Erfahrung in Sprach- und Sprachtherapie. ERFAHRUNG In Bezug auf die Erfahrung sollten Sie die Fähigkeit demonstrieren, die Bedürfnisse eines Schülers zu bewerten und geeignete Interventionen zu entwickeln, sowohl in kleinen Gruppen als auch in größeren Klassen. Frühere Erfahrungen in der Arbeit mit Kindern im Vorschul- / Grundschulalter mit spezifischen Lernbedürfnissen werden sehr geschätzt, ebenso wie das Verständnis vertraulicher Prozesse und die Verpflichtung zur Wahrung der Vertraulichkeit. Darüber hinaus werden Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Kulturen und Vertrautheit mit Programmen für High-Potential (HP) Studenten als vorteilhaft angesehen. WESENTLICHE INFORMATIONEN Es ist wichtig, dass der Posteninhaber immer die Kinderschutzrichtlinien kennt und eine professionelle Distanz zu den Schülern einhält, während er dennoch effektive Arbeits- und Pflegebeziehungen entwickelt. Sie verstehen und umarmen die Bedeutung von Vielfalt und Inklusion und stehen gegen Diskriminierung in jeglicher Form. Hintergrunduntersuchungen und Referenzkontrollen der vergangenen zehn Jahre werden während des Auswahlprozesses durchgeführt. WER WIR SIND Collège du Léman ist eine der renommiertesten internationalen Schulen der Schweiz am Rande des Genfer Sees mit Blick auf die Schweizer Alpen. Wir begrüßen Kinder von 2 bis 18 Jahren, um Teil einer wirklich internationalen Gemeinschaft mit mehr als 120 verschiedenen Nationalitäten zu werden. Unsere Vision ist es, Generationen zu formen, die Unterschiede nutzen und unsere Schüler dazu befähigen, die Welt zum Besseren zu verändern. Wir fördern individuelle Stärken durch unsere hervorragenden Pädagogen und die schiere Breite der Möglichkeiten, die wir als Teil unseres Lehrplans und unserer Aktivitäten anbieten.

PRINCIPAUX OBJECTIFS DU RÔLE L'enseignant de soutien à l'apprentissage bilingue offre des services de soutien à l'apprentissage souples dans l'ensemble de l'école en fonction des besoins opérationnels. Le rôle consiste à identifier les besoins d'apprentissage des élèves et à les aider à réaliser leur plein potentiel dans l'environnement scolaire chaque fois que possible. L'enseignant de soutien à l'apprentissage collabore étroitement avec les enseignants, les chefs d'école, les parents et les professionnels de l'extérieur pour s'assurer que les stratégies de soutien correspondent aux besoins individuels des élèves. En partenariat avec les enseignants de classe, l'enseignant de soutien à l'apprentissage élabore et fournit des interventions ciblées qui peuvent, le cas échéant, être intégrées à la pratique courante en classe. Ce poste offre des affectations flexibles en fonction des besoins de l'école et peut impliquer de soutenir les élèves de différents groupes d'année et des programmes de soutien à l'apprentissage. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS L'enseignant de soutien à l'apprentissage est responsable, en collaboration avec l'enseignant, de :
• Planification, organisation et mise en œuvre d'interventions spécifiques pour développer l'alphabétisation, le calcul et les compétences linguistiques pour les étudiants qui ont identifié des différences d'apprentissage spécifiques (pour inclure HP)
• Fournir en classe un support ou de petits groupes, selon le cas
• Fournir un soutien de 1:1 aux étudiants ayant des différences d'apprentissage importantes qui ont été identifiées par une évaluation externe. Cela implique:
• Compléter les observations et les évaluations des élèves.
• Collaborer avec les enseignants pour fournir des suggestions et des plans de gestion en classe concernant les élèves identifiés
• Assistants de mentorat et personnel d ' appui selon les besoins
• Communication avec les parents en collaboration avec l'enseignant, le directeur ou le député
• Collaborer avec le conseiller scolaire et des spécialistes externes
• Fournir régulièrement des commentaires aux principaux/députés. Responsabilités supplémentaires
• Présenter un modèle de rôle positif en employant des interactions appropriées et respectueuses avec les étudiants et le personnel
• Tenir ses propres dossiers pour les étudiants identifiés.
• Diriger des ateliers avec des enseignants et d'autres membres du personnel pour le perfectionnement professionnel
• Rester à jour dans le domaine des différences d'apprentissage en participant à des programmes en service, à des séances de formation du personnel mandaté et à des ateliers et conférences auto-sélectionnés.
• Participation à des examens ou autres réunions connexes
• Aider à la surveillance des terrains de jeux et des activités spéciales sur demande. COMPÉTENCES (Les capacités dont l'individu a besoin pour s'acquitter efficacement de ce rôle)
• Bonnes compétences organisationnelles
• Établir et entretenir des relations positives avec les élèves et les parents.
• Aptitude à prendre des initiatives et à assumer des responsabilités
• Sensibilisation aux processus confidentiels et capacité de respecter la confidentialité
• Capacité de travailler en équipe
• Dynamique, engagé mais flexible
• Volonté de prendre en compte les derniers développements en matière d'éducation pour les personnes ayant des différences d'apprentissage (y compris HP) et un engagement en faveur du perfectionnement professionnel continu
• Capacité d'utiliser IPADS/ordinateurs pour stimuler l'intérêt pour l'apprentissage
• Capacité de travailler avec des logiciels Office (Word, Excel, Outlook...)
• Évaluer les étudiants de façon formelle et informelle, y compris les évaluations standardisées, les trieurs et les utiliser pour évaluer les données afin d'aider les étudiants dans le besoin.
• Fournir régulièrement des commentaires sur les progrès et les réalisations aux enseignants et aux parents de chaque élève.
• L'enseignant de soutien à l'apprentissage servira de gestionnaire de cas pour les étudiants recevant des services de soutien à l'apprentissage, y compris la rédaction de PEI et la tenue à jour de la liste des étudiants de soutien à l'apprentissage
• Fluent en anglais (niveau C1 minimum lecture/écriture). Français souhaitable au niveau B1. Compétences souhaitables :
• Familiariser avec le cadre d ' intégration du système
• Expérience en administration d'évaluations normalisées et de dépistages diagnostiques.
• Un minimum de 2 ans d'enseignement/d'apprentissage spécial dans un cadre diversifié QUALIFICATION Pour être considéré pour ce poste, vous devez posséder un BA (QTS)/BSc (QTS) ou équivalent, ou un BA/BSc avec un PGCE ou un MA en éducation spéciale. Par ailleurs, une qualification B.Ed ou CAPSAIS/CAPA-SH est également acceptable. Les qualifications privilégiées comprennent l'expérience en orthophonie et en thérapie linguistique. EXPÉRIENCE En termes d'expérience, vous devez démontrer une capacité d'évaluer les besoins d'un étudiant et développer des interventions appropriées, à la fois en petits groupes et dans des classes plus grandes. L'expérience antérieure de travail avec les enfants d'âge préscolaire ou primaire ayant des besoins d'apprentissage spécifiques est très appréciée, ainsi qu'une compréhension des processus confidentiels et un engagement à respecter la confidentialité. En outre, l'expérience avec différentes cultures et la connaissance des programmes pour les étudiants à haut potentiel (HP) sont considérées comme avantageuses. CE QU'IL FAUT SAVOIR Il est important que le titulaire du poste soit toujours conscient des lignes directrices en matière de protection de l'enfance et observe une distance professionnelle par rapport aux étudiants tout en développant des relations de travail et de soins efficaces. Vous comprenez et acceptez l'importance de la diversité, de l'inclusion et de la lutte contre la discrimination sous quelque forme que ce soit. Au cours du processus de sélection, des enquêtes de fond et des vérifications des références seront effectuées au cours des dix dernières années. QUI NOUS sommes Collège du Léman est l'une des écoles internationales les plus prestigieuses de Suisse, situé au bord du lac Léman en vue des Alpes suisses. Nous accueillons les enfants de 2 à 18 ans pour faire partie d'une communauté véritablement internationale ayant plus de 120 nationalités différentes. Notre vision est de façonner des générations qui exploitent les différences et permettent à nos étudiants de changer le monde pour le mieux. Nous cultivons nos forces individuelles par l'entremise de nos éducateurs exceptionnels et de l'ampleur des possibilités que nous offrons dans le cadre de notre programme et de nos activités.

jobs.description:
La Cote International School (LCIS) is a school that aims to make a difference every day. We are passionate about education and seeing young people grow and develop, and we want the same for our colleagues. If you join us, you will become part of a team that is a genuine family, committed to each other and to the students we serve. LCIS is a co-educational, English language based, day school that welcomes nearly 450 students between 3 and 18 years old. Nestled in Switzerland amongst vineyards and fruit orchards, between Lac Léman and the Jura mountains, we are also within very easy commuting distance from Geneva and Lausanne. It is a truly great environment to live and work. We offer our students unparalleled international learning experiences, including those inspired by our collaborations with Juilliard, MIT and UNICEF. Our customized curriculum offers our students the opportunity to follow an English, French or bilingual pathway leading to the internationally renowned International Baccalaureate Diploma Program (IBDP), as well as discovering new skills, abilities and interest. It is in this dynamic environment that we invite you to apply to join our team: Learning Support Assistants (Student Shadows) Speculative applications – primary – secondary – hourly role Responsibilities:
• Provide support to students with additional learning needs within the classroom.
• Motivate students to achieve beyond their potential.
• Encourage students to communicate effectively.
• Help children understand instructions.
• Assist children who need extra support to complete various tasks.
• Supervise group activities.
• Communicate with teachers, the SEN department and parents about student progress. Qualifications and Skills:
• 1-3 years of experience in a similar role.
• Fluency in English; working knowledge of French is an asset.
• Relevant degree.
• Excellent communication skills, discretion, and a team player attitude.
• Empathetic, calm, positive, motivational, creative, and flexible.
• Availability throughout the day and week during school hours.
• Local residency.
• Clear criminal record. If you are passionate about education and interested in joining our team, please apply directly online through our website. Please note that this is an ongoing advertisement, as we may have unexpected Learning Support needs arise throughout the year, though there may not be an immediate vacancy at this time. If you share our passion for education and would like to join our team, please apply directly online through our website.

jobs.title: Nurse on-call
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE Collège du Léman is one of Switzerland’s most prestigious international schools, located on the edge of Lake Geneva in view of the Swiss Alps. ​ We welcome children from 2 to 18 years old to become part of a truly international community with more than 120 different nationalities. Our vision is to shape generations that harness differences and empower our students to change the world for the better. We nurture individual strengths through our outstanding educators and the sheer breadth of opportunities that we offer as part of our curriculum and activities. Collège du Léman is part of the Nord Anglia Education family of more than 80 premium schools, educating students in over 30 countries. MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE To ensure the safe and efficient delivery of clinical care within the school The School Nurse – On Call plays a key role in ensuring the safe, responsive and high-quality delivery of nursing care within the school environment. Working collaboratively as part of a team of three school nurses, the role supports students’ physical wellbeing while contributing to a calm, caring and professional medical service. The nurse communicates effectively and professionally with students, parents, staff and school leadership, ensuring that all medical information is handled with accuracy, discretion and confidentiality. Medical centre records and administrative tasks are maintained in line with school and regulatory requirements. This is an on-call position, with working hours scheduled according to the operational needs of the department. Additional availability may be required during the summer period, in line with school activities, camps and student presence. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Delivering safe, high-quality and efficient nursing care to students while on duty, in line with professional standards and school policies.
• Assessing health needs independently and providing appropriate care, treatment and follow-up, including responding effectively to medical emergencies.
• Maintaining accurate, clear and up-to-date medical records, ensuring confidentiality and compliance with regulatory and school requirements.
• Upholding safeguarding, child protection principles and professional boundaries at all times.
• Acting as a key link between the Medical Centre and the wider school community, promoting effective communication with students, parents, boarding staff and academic teams.
• Communicating professionally and compassionately with parents regarding students’ health, wellbeing and any required follow-up.
• Supporting health education, prevention and wellbeing initiatives within the school as required.
• Demonstrating flexibility and adaptability to meet the evolving operational needs of the department, including on-call duties and seasonal peak periods. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
• Demonstrating evidence of ongoing professional development and a genuine interest in primary nursing and adolescent healthcare.
• Applying strong clinical judgement and remaining calm, resilient and effective when working under pressure or in emergency situations.
• Communicating clearly, professionally and empathetically with students, parents, colleagues and school leadership.
• Building positive and trusting relationships while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries.
• Working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team and contributing to a supportive and efficient medical service.
• Adapting flexibly to changing priorities, on-call requirements and seasonal variations in workload.
• Showing cultural awareness and sensitivity within a diverse international school community.
• Managing time effectively and maintaining high standards of organisation and attention to detail. Qualificiation A nursing qualification recognised by Swiss law is required . Previous experience in emergency and paediatric nursing is highly desirable.The role requires excellent oral and written communication skills in both English and French. Prior knowledge of primary nursing and healthcare education for adolescents will be considered a strong asset. ESSENTIAL INFORMATION It is important that the post holder is always aware of Child Protection guidelines and observes a professional distance from students whilst still developing effective working and caring relationships. You understand and embrace the importance of diversity and inclusion and stand against discrimination in any form. Background investigations and reference checks for the past ten years will be conducted during the selection process.

MAIN PURPOSE DEL RUOLO Per garantire la consegna sicura ed efficiente dell'assistenza clinica all'interno della scuola La Scuola Infermiera – On Call svolge un ruolo chiave nel garantire la consegna sicura, reattiva e di alta qualità dell'assistenza sanitaria all'interno dell'ambiente scolastico. Lavorando in collaborazione come parte di un team di tre infermiere scolastiche, il ruolo supporta il benessere fisico degli studenti, contribuendo a un servizio medico calmo, attento e professionale. L'infermiera comunica efficacemente e professionalmente con studenti, genitori, personale e leadership scolastica, assicurando che tutte le informazioni mediche siano gestite con accuratezza, discrezione e riservatezza. I registri del centro medico e i compiti amministrativi sono mantenuti in linea con i requisiti scolastici e normativi. Si tratta di una posizione on-call, con orari di lavoro programmati in base alle esigenze operative del dipartimento. Ulteriori disponibilità possono essere richieste durante il periodo estivo, in linea con le attività scolastiche, i campi e la presenza degli studenti. RISPOSTE DI LAVORO
• Fornire assistenza infermieristica sicura, di alta qualità ed efficiente agli studenti mentre sono in servizio, in linea con gli standard professionali e le politiche scolastiche.
• Valutare le esigenze di salute in modo indipendente e fornire cure adeguate, trattamento e follow-up, compreso rispondere efficacemente alle emergenze mediche.
• Mantenere registri medici accurati, chiari e aggiornati, garantendo la riservatezza e il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e scolastici.
• Sostenere la tutela, i principi di protezione dei bambini e i confini professionali in ogni momento.
• Agire come un collegamento chiave tra il Centro Medico e la più ampia comunità scolastica, promuovendo una comunicazione efficace con studenti, genitori, personale di imbarco e team accademici.
• Comunicare professionalmente e compassionevolmente con i genitori per quanto riguarda la salute degli studenti, il benessere e qualsiasi follow-up richiesto.
• Sostenere le iniziative di educazione sanitaria, prevenzione e benessere all'interno della scuola.
• Dimostrando flessibilità e adattabilità per soddisfare le esigenze operative in evoluzione del reparto, compresi i dazi on-call e i periodi di picco stagionale. SKILLE E COMPETENZE
• Dimostrando le prove dello sviluppo professionale in corso e un autentico interesse per la cura primaria e la salute degli adolescenti.
• Applicando forte giudizio clinico e rimanendo calma, resiliente ed efficace quando si lavora sotto pressione o in situazioni di emergenza.
• Comunicare chiaramente, professionalmente ed empaticamente con studenti, genitori, colleghi e leadership scolastica.
• Costruire relazioni positive e fiduciose mantenendo i confini professionali appropriati.
• Lavorare collaborativamente all'interno di un team multidisciplinare e contribuire a un servizio medico di supporto ed efficiente.
• Adattare in modo flessibile al cambiamento delle priorità, alle esigenze di vendita e alle variazioni stagionali del carico di lavoro.
• Mostrare la consapevolezza culturale e la sensibilità all'interno di una variegata comunità scolastica internazionale.
• Gestione efficace del tempo e mantenimento di elevati standard di organizzazione e attenzione ai dettagli. Qualificiazione Una qualifica di allattamento riconosciuta dal diritto svizzero è richiesta. Esperienza precedente in emergenza e allattamento pediatrico è altamente auspicabile. Il ruolo richiede eccellenti capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta sia in inglese che in francese. La conoscenza prioritaria dell'istruzione primaria e sanitaria per gli adolescenti sarà considerata un bene forte. INFORMAZIONI ESSENTI È importante che il titolare del post sia sempre a conoscenza delle linee guida per la protezione dei bambini e osservi una distanza professionale dagli studenti, pur sviluppando relazioni di lavoro e cura efficaci. Voi comprendete e abbracciate l'importanza della diversità e dell'inclusione e mettetevi contro la discriminazione in qualsiasi forma. Le indagini di fondo e i controlli di riferimento per gli ultimi dieci anni saranno condotti durante il processo di selezione.

• Flexible Anpassung an sich ändernde Prioritäten, Bereitschaftsdienste und saisonale Schwankungen der Arbeitsbelastung.

QUI NOUS sommes Collège du Léman est l'une des écoles internationales les plus prestigieuses de Suisse, situé au bord du lac Léman en vue des Alpes suisses. Nous accueillons des enfants de 2 à 18 ans pour faire partie d'une communauté internationale authentique avec plus de 120 nationalités différentes. Notre vision est de façonner des générations qui exploitent les différences et permettent à nos élèves de changer le monde pour le mieux. Nous cultivons nos forces individuelles par l'entremise de nos éducateurs exceptionnels et de l'ampleur des possibilités que nous offrons dans le cadre de notre programme et de nos activités. Le Collège du Léman fait partie de la famille Nord Anglia Education de plus de 80 écoles premium, éduquant des étudiants dans plus de 30 pays. PRINCIPAUX OBJECTIFS DU RÔLE Pour assurer la prestation sécuritaire et efficace des soins cliniques à l'école L'infirmière de l'école – On Call joue un rôle clé dans la prestation sécuritaire, réactive et de haute qualité des soins infirmiers dans le milieu scolaire. Travaillant en collaboration dans le cadre d'une équipe de trois infirmières de l'école, ce rôle soutient le bien-être physique des élèves tout en contribuant à un service médical calme, attentionné et professionnel. L'infirmière communique efficacement et professionnellement avec les élèves, les parents, le personnel et la direction de l'école, en veillant à ce que tous les renseignements médicaux soient traités avec exactitude, discrétion et confidentialité. Les dossiers des centres médicaux et les tâches administratives sont tenus conformément aux exigences de l'école et de la réglementation. Il s'agit d'un poste de garde, avec des heures de travail prévues en fonction des besoins opérationnels du ministère. Des disponibilités supplémentaires peuvent être requises pendant la période estivale, conformément aux activités scolaires, aux camps et à la présence des élèves. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS
• Fournir des soins infirmiers sûrs, de haute qualité et efficaces aux élèves pendant leur service, conformément aux normes professionnelles et aux politiques scolaires.
• Évaluer les besoins en matière de santé de façon indépendante et fournir les soins, le traitement et le suivi appropriés, y compris répondre efficacement aux urgences médicales.
• Maintenir des dossiers médicaux exacts, clairs et à jour, en assurant la confidentialité et la conformité aux exigences réglementaires et scolaires.
• Maintien des principes de protection de l'enfance et des limites professionnelles en tout temps.
• En tant que lien essentiel entre le Centre médical et l'ensemble de la communauté scolaire, promouvoir une communication efficace avec les élèves, les parents, le personnel des internats et les équipes universitaires.
• Communication professionnelle et compatissante avec les parents concernant la santé, le bien-être et tout suivi nécessaire.
• Soutenir les initiatives en matière d'éducation, de prévention et de bien-être en milieu scolaire, selon les besoins.
• Faire preuve de souplesse et d'adaptabilité pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels changeants du Ministère, y compris les fonctions de garde et les périodes de pointe saisonnières. COMPÉTENCES
• Démontrer des preuves de développement professionnel continu et un véritable intérêt pour les soins infirmiers primaires et les soins aux adolescents.
• Appliquer un jugement clinique fort et rester calme, résistant et efficace lorsque vous travaillez sous pression ou en situation d'urgence.
• Communiquer clairement, professionnellement et empathiquement avec les élèves, les parents, les collègues et le leadership scolaire.
• Établir des relations positives et confiantes tout en maintenant des limites professionnelles appropriées.
• Travailler en collaboration au sein d'une équipe multidisciplinaire et contribuer à un service médical de soutien et efficace.
• S'adapter avec souplesse aux changements de priorités, aux besoins en matière d'appel et aux variations saisonnières de la charge de travail.
• Faire preuve de sensibilisation et de sensibilité culturelles au sein d'une communauté scolaire internationale diversifiée.
• Gérer efficacement le temps et maintenir des normes élevées d'organisation et d'attention aux détails. Qualification Une qualification en sciences infirmières reconnue par la loi suisse est requise. Une expérience antérieure en soins infirmiers d'urgence et pédiatriques est hautement souhaitable. Le rôle exige d'excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite en français et en anglais. La connaissance préalable des soins infirmiers primaires et de l'éducation sanitaire des adolescents sera considérée comme un atout important. CE QU'IL FAUT SAVOIR Il est important que le titulaire de poste soit toujours conscient des lignes directrices en matière de protection de l'enfance et observe une distance professionnelle par rapport aux étudiants tout en développant des relations de travail et de soins efficaces. Vous comprenez et reconnaissez l'importance de la diversité, de l'inclusion et de la lutte contre toute forme de discrimination. Des enquêtes de fond et des vérifications des références seront effectuées au cours du processus de sélection au cours des dix dernières années.

jobs.description:
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE To deliver engaging and high-quality after-school Russian language tuition to students from 7 to 18 years old, fostering language development in a supportive and stimulating learning environment. You will work after class hours, with the number of hours depending on the requirements. This is an hourly-paid contract. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES The Russian Teacher will:
• Plan, prepare and deliver engaging after-school Russian lessons.
• Develop appropriate teaching resources, lesson plans and learning materials tailored to students' age, ability and language proficiency.
• Differentiate teaching to meet the individual learning needs of students.
• Monitor students' progress and provide constructive feedback to students and, where appropriate, to parents.
• Create a positive, inclusive and motivating classroom environment that encourages active participation.
• Maintain accurate attendance records and communicate any concerns to the relevant school staff.
• Work collaboratively with colleagues to ensure consistency with the school's educational standards and values.
• Undertake any other duties reasonably required by the manager. CANDIDATE PROFILE Qualification
• University degree in Russian studies or a related subject.
• Recognised teaching qualification. Experience
• Experience teaching Russian to primary-aged children up to high school.
• Previous experience in an international school or multilingual environment would be an advantage. Knowledge and Skills
• Excellent command of Russian (native or near-native level).
• Ability to plan and deliver engaging, age-appropriate language lessons.
• Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build positive relationships with young learners.
• Good organisational and time management skills.
• ICT literacy, including the use of educational technologies and standard office software.
• Good working knowledge of English. Knowledge of French would be an advantage. Personal Attributes
• Enthusiastic, reliable and committed to supporting students' language development.
• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
• Flexible and adaptable in response to the needs of the school.
• Ability to work to deadlines and maintain high professional standards. All areas of this job description are subject to regular review and may be amended to meet the changing needs of the school. ESSENTIAL INFORMATION It is important that the post holder is always aware of Child Protection guidelines and observes a professional distance from students whilst still developing effective working and caring relationships. You understand and embrace the importance of diversity and inclusion and stand against discrimination in any form. Background investigations and reference checks for the past ten years will be conducted during the selection process. • Laurea in studi russi o un soggetto correlato.

• Ottimo comando del russo (livello nativo o quasi nativo).
• Capacità di pianificare e fornire lezioni di lingua coinvolgenti e adatte all'età.
• Buona comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di costruire relazioni positive con i giovani studenti.
• Buone capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo.

• Buona conoscenza del lavoro dell'inglese. La conoscenza del francese sarebbe un vantaggio. Attributi personali
• Enthusiastic, affidabile e impegnata a sostenere lo sviluppo linguistico degli studenti.
• Capacità di lavorare efficacemente sia indipendentemente che come parte di una squadra.
• Flessibile e adattabile in risposta alle esigenze della scuola.

Nutriamo i punti di forza individuali attraverso i nostri eccellenti educatori e la pura ampiezza delle opportunità che offriamo come parte del nostro curriculum e delle nostre attività. Collège du Léman fa parte della famiglia Nord Anglia Education di oltre 80 scuole premium, educando studenti in oltre 30 paesi.

jobs.description:
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE You will provide, lead, and supervise a variety of activities within the Extracurricular Department. You will also be responsible for maintaining and updating communication with the department team as well as with CDL parents whose children attend the programs. As an Activity Leader, you will work within the following time windows: between 3:00 p.m. and 6:45 p.m. on weekdays, and from 12:00 p.m. on Wednesdays, for a total of 15 hours and 30 minutes per week. Your exact working hours may vary slightly depending on operational needs. The position is to be taken from mid-November ideally. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Providing attentive supervision and support to students throughout the day, ensuring their safe movement between activities, facilities, and designated locations
• Supervising and coordinating activities with external providers, on and off campus
• Maintaining effective communication and responding promptly to emergencies or safeguarding concerns
• Maintaining and updating administrative and operational tracking tools SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
• Language: fluent both in English and French
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
• Ability to engage in an empathetic, yet effective manner
• Strong analytical skills
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team
• Positive attitude
• Results-oriented
• Proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
• Optional: Familiarity with the iSams platform ESSENTIAL INFORMATION It is important that the post holder is always aware of Child Protection guidelines and observes a professional distance from students whilst still developing effective working and caring relationships. You understand and embrace the importance of diversity and inclusion and stand against discrimination in any form. Background investigations and reference checks for the past ten years will be conducted during the selection process. WHO WE ARE Collège du Léman is one of Switzerland’s most prestigious international day and boarding schools, located on the edge of Lake Geneva in view of the Swiss Alps. Collège du Léman is a member of the Nord Anglia family of more than 89+ schools worldwide. At Collège du Léman, we shape generations that harness differences, changing our world for the better, and are proud of our “RISE” (Respect, Internationalism, Spirit and Excellence) values. We are a truly international community of more than 120 different nationalities. These come together on a green, village-like campus covering 8 hectares. Students follow national and international curricula, with English, French and Bilingual programmes offered.
